description:
Look at an image: an upload or a finished job's result, the whole of it or a part, as a picture you can see.

Give `input_key` or `job_id`. It is free and needs no go-ahead: each look is a free job on the `echo` test model that makes a reduced copy, which the user's dashboard leaves out. Look at the whole image first: the answer states its full size in pixels. Then, to judge detail, look at a small part with `roi`, which comes back pixel for pixel when it fits within `max_side`.

`roi` is in fractions of the full-size image, as a job's is, and the answer gives the `roi` for the part it shows, ready to send to a job.

input_key.description: The image: the `input_key` upload_photo answered with, or a File ID the user copied from their CraterView.ai workspace.

job_id.description: A finished job's `id`, to look at its result.

max_side.description: The longest side of the picture you get back, in pixels. 1024 is enough for a first look at the whole image; a part that fits within this comes back pixel for pixel.

roi.description: The part to look at, as fractions of the full-size image's width and height the way up it is shown, from the top left: the `roi` a job takes. Leave it out for the whole image.

name: view_photo
